records.claim: The product label for azathioprine recommends that women who are breastfeeding do not use this medication because of concerns based on animal studies. However, several medical organizations consider azathioprine 6-MP compatible with breastfeeding. For many women, the benefits of continuing treatment while breastfeeding may outweigh the possible risks. Be sure to talk with your healthcare provider about all your breastfeeding questions.
